scope: Huggin-style floating bottom navigation for NGS Plus

design.surface: Rounded frosted light/dark surface, 28px radius, 14px outer margins, 560px maximum width
design.selection: Burgundy selected pill; light rose in dark mode
design.primaryDestination: 64px circular QR control with selected ring
design.type: 11px system font; labels wrap at larger accessibility sizes
design.keyboard: Navigation hidden while keyboard is shown; ordered Tab/Enter traversal supported
design.motion: 220ms feedback; zero duration when reduced motion is enabled

verification.responsive: 320px, 200% type, Turkish/English, light/dark; labels not clipped, all targets at least 48px
verification.safeArea: Final scroll content action remains visible above floating bar and tappable
verification.semantics: Five named buttons; one selected destination; QR keyboard activation passed
verification.stateRetention: History/Home state and QR visibility tests passed; keyboard dismissal preserves selection

simulator.visualReview: Floating surface, selected home pill and center QR button visually inspected on actual home screen
simulator.screenshot: Local temporary capture only, because home contains user information
